shortlist.label: IgG4-related hypophysitis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated serum IgG4 and pituitary MRI findings consistent with hypophysitis

shortlist.label: Lymphocytic hypophysitis
shortlist.why_kept: Pituitary dysfunction and inflammation suggested by laboratory and imaging findings

shortlist.label: Granulomatous hypophysitis
shortlist.why_kept: Pituitary MRI showing diffuse swelling and a poorly enhancing mass, consistent with granulomatous inflammation

shortlist.label: Pituitary adenoma
shortlist.why_kept: 7-mm poorly enhancing mass in the right anterior lobe on pituitary MRI, potentially causing hypopituitarism

shortlist.label: Sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated IgG4 and granulomatous inflammation suggested by pituitary MRI, with potential for systemic involvement

raw.rationale: The patient's elevated serum IgG4 levels, combined with the imaging findings of diffuse swelling of the pituitary body and stalk, and the presence of a poorly enhancing mass in the right anterior lobe, are consistent with IgG4-related hypophysitis. Additionally, the patient's hypopituitarism and the presence of a nodular lesion in the left lung field, suggestive of systemic IgG4-related disease, further support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Lymphocytic hypophysitis
rejected.why: While lymphocytic hypophysitis can also cause hypopituitarism and pituitary swelling, the elevated IgG4 levels and systemic findings are more suggestive of IgG4-related hypophysitis.
